title: Technical Product Manager Iii
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Technical Product Manager Iii role at Outliant . Outliant is a fully‑remote, US‑based, digital product development and startup consulting company with a team of diverse creators who help conceive seamless digital products.

Our teams emphasize growth, creativity, and the freedom to think outside the box.

About This Role

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager with a strong analytical mindset and a proven ability to lead platform‑focused initiatives.

You’ll join one of our most strategic accounts: a fast‑scaling wellness company with a national footprint in the US. This is not a feature factory role.

You’ll be driving cross‑functional outcomes, owning platform reliability and scalability, and partnering closely with engineering, SEO, and CRO teams to deliver meaningful impact.

You’ll operate within a newly structured product org where “stability & enablement” is a core business unit — and platform work is treated as first‑class priority.

This role reports directly to internal product leadership and collaborates with senior stakeholders across engineering, data, SEO, and design.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the platform roadmap: manage initiatives related to site architecture, CMS performance, scalability, QA, and SEO foundations — ensuring readiness for 5× growth in clinics and locations.
  • Be technical and decisive: work closely with engineers to debug, unblock, and scope technical solutions.
  • Bridge the gap between messy reality and scalable execution.
  • Drive clarity and impact: translate business outcomes into clear product specs, track results, and relentlessly prioritize high‑leverage opportunities.
  • Lead discovery & validation: partner with PMs and stakeholders to validate and prioritize internal and client‑facing requests using a structured intake and scoring system.
  • Support SEO enablement: while you won’t own SEO strategy, you’ll ensure the technical platform supports the SEO team’s roadmap — including performance, schema, and scalable content rollout.
  • Own documentation & communication: write clear PRDs, surface tradeoffs, and ensure shared understanding across engineering, QA, and stakeholders.
  • Manage cross‑team dependencies: coordinate work between engineering, QA, data, and operations — ensuring blockers are addressed and initiatives stay aligned to roadmap outcomes.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years as a Product Manager, ideally with a technical or platform focus.
  • Background in engineering or strong technical fluency (e.g., able to discuss code, debug issues, or evaluate feasibility).
  • Experience managing CMS‑based systems (e.g., Webflow or headless CMS) at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across disciplines — engineering, SEO, design — and drive cross‑functional alignment.
  • Highly analytical — able to define success metrics, pull data, and present insights to drive prioritization and decision‑making.
  • Hands‑on experience with modern product development practices: agile, Kanban, discovery frameworks, backlog grooming, etc.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Clear PRDs and structured documentation are table stakes.

What’s in it for you?

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Non‑working holidays per country of residence
  • Referral bonuses
  • Monthly internet stipend
  • Fun and casual work environment
  • Employee engagement activities and virtual gatherings
  • We are a diverse, global team!

To ensure the legitimacy of job opportunities, we strongly recommend that you solely rely on positions posted here on our official website: outliant.com/careers. All our current job openings require video interviews conducted in either or both synchronous (via Google Meet) and asynchronous (via Willo) formats.

description:

Type: Full-time

Reports to: CEO

About the Role:

We’re scaling multiple premium lifestyle brands through our direct-to-consumer Shopify stores. We’re looking for someone who can own the DTC funnel from top to bottom—someone who sees revenue gaps and plugs them, who understands testing velocity, landing page strategy, and how to turn a one-time buyer into a returning customer.

You won’t be alone—you’ll have a Shopify dev/execution teammate, email support, and a CX partner. But you’re in the driver’s seat.

KPIs You’ll Own:

  • Conversion Rate (site-wide and per traffic source)
  • Email Revenue % (campaigns and flows)
  • Bounce Rate and Cart Abandonment
  • Shopify revenue growth (MoM and YoY)

What You Bring:

  • 2–3+ years experience running or scaling DTC funnels in Shopify
  • A/B testing instincts and a toolkit (PageFly, Google Optimize, Hotjar, etc.)
  • Comfort planning and owning growth strategy across traffic, offer, and retention
  • Able to write or brief copy that sells
  • Knows what metrics matter and how to improve them
  • Doesn’t wait for direction—owns results, moves fast, and learns faster

Tools We Use:

  • Hotjar or Microsoft Clarity

What We Offer:

  • Full ownership of the DTC funnel—your strategy, your execution
  • Fast decision-making, zero red tape
  • Hands-on mentorship from founder and performance lead
  • Bonus tied directly to results
  • A chance to leave your fingerprint on 3 global brands

title: Technical Architect
description:
As a Salesforce Technical Architect Comunications , The Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers.

You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Architecture: Lead technical design sessions and translate complex business requirements into well-architected solutions that leverage the Salesforce platform and its various products, SFI Industries, APEX and Omnistudio
  • Technical Leadership: You might lead a team of developers guiding them though the best practices, providing them an end to end vision, value driven scalable solutions, your solutions include but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products, APIs, Lightning Experience & Component development, Apex/Visualforce, mobile development technologies, and integration middleware/ETL technologies.
  • Release & DevOps Management: Lead/manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migrations. You will contribute to establish and manage DevOps strategies, including CI/CD pipelines, version control (GIT ), and environment management for large-scale implementations.
  • Project Collaboration: Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, set expectations, and identify gaps between their current and desired states. You will also participate in pre-sales activities such as discovery sessions and Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development.
  • System Integration: Architect and manage integrations with external systems via APIs and ETL technologies. You should have a strong background in designing and building large web-based systems.
  • Problem-Solving: Proactively debug and resolve complex technical issues as they arise, applying a deep understanding of the project and its components.
  • Salesforce Liaison: Work with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations and ensure solutions align with platform best practices.
  • Travel: Be prepared for travel to client sites, averaging approximately 50% of the time, to collaborate effectively with global teams and stakeholders.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 9+ years of experience as a technical architect, with at least 6+ years on the Salesforce platform.
  • Platform Expertise: Expert-level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Analytics, and Experience Clouds, with OmniStudio and SFI knowledge being a plus.
  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of systems architecture, key design and integration patterns, and best practices for managing large data volumes. You should also be familiar with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth ).
  • Development Background: Strong background in designing and developing large web-based systems, including a comprehensive understanding of the full software product lifecycle.
  • DevOps & Release Management: Experience with environment management, release management, code versioning, and deployment methodologies.
  • Security & Data: Familiarity with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL ) and data sharing/visibility models.
  • Soft Skills: Be a proactive and self-managed professional with the ability to challenge the status quo and propose creative yet well-thought-out solutions.
  • Required Certifications (3 or more):
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified App Builder
    • Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified Administrator / Advanced Administrator
    • Salesforce Certified Omnistudio Developer
    • Salesforce Certified Application Architect
    • Salesforce Certified System Architect
  • English proficient

Nice to Have Skills

  • Prior experience in the Communications Cloud, Media Cloud salesforce industries.
  • Certifications: Active Salesforce certifications or the ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire. Candidates with the Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials are highly desirable.

description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas. Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga A pessoa escolhida irá trabalhar no time de Apps, responsáveis pela manutenção e evolução dos aplicativos disponibilizados pela BigDataCorp no mercado. O foco será no BigID, uma avançada ferramenta de validação de identidade e prevenção à fraude. A atuação será no gerenciamento do desenvolvimento nas subcélulas de Documentoscopia, Biometria, KBA, Device Id e BackgroundCheck. O profissional será responsável por maximizar o valor gerado pelas aplicações, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico do desenvolvimento e a eficiência operacional da equipe em um cenário de crescente automação e complexidade tecnológica.

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida das funcionalidades, desde a tradução de requisitos em histórias de usuário até a priorização do backlog com base em um raciocínio estruturado e critérios de impacto, ROI e esforço;
  • Desenvolver e manter o roadmap estratégico das aplicações, identificando e planejando as iniciativas futuras que garantirão a evolução e a competitividade do produto;
  • Liderar a execução tática da equipe no dia a dia, facilitando as cerimônias ágeis, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho no Jira e removendo impedimentos para garantir a previsibilidade das entregas;
  • Atuar como um mentor para a equipe, fomentando uma cultura de autonomia, segurança psicológica e melhoria contínua, e garantindo que o time compreenda o "porquê" estratégico por trás das tarefas que executam;
  • Definir e acompanhar os KPIs e métricas de sucesso para cada entrega, aplicando senso crítico para avaliar o desempenho das funcionalidades no nível operacional e validando hipóteses com testes A/B;
  • Consolidar os resultados e dados de produto para comunicar o valor gerado e o alinhamento com os OKRs da empresa, garantindo o engajamento e a visibilidade junto aos stakeholders e à diretoria;
  • Estabelecer e operar um sistema contínuo de coleta e análise de feedback, dados de uso e entrevistas com clientes para compreender profundamente o desempenho e a usabilidade do produto;
  • Utilizar os insights coletados para realizar análises de mercado, identificar tendências e descobrir novas oportunidades ou dores de clientes não atendidas, informando a estratégia de longo prazo

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência em gestão de produtos digitais (ex.: Product Manager, Product Owner etc.), idealmente em ambientes de tecnologia B2B;
  • Elevado senso crítico e raciocínio estruturado para decompor problemas complexos, questionar premissas e validar informações em um ambiente com crescente uso de automação e IA;
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado contínuo, com autonomia para se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias, metodologias e tendências de mercado;
  • Inteligência emocional e maturidade para atuar como uma ponte eficaz entre negócio e tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns) e gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: Jira);
  • Perfil analítico e voltado a dados para fundamentar decisões estratégicas e de priorização;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, de equipes técnicas a executivos, tanto internamente quanto com clientes externos

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos

  • Vivência no setor de dados, analytics ou em plataformas SaaS de alta complexidade;
  • Visão estratégica sobre o impacto e a aplicação de Inteligência Artificial no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e na evolução de produtos digitais;
  • Compreensão de arquiteturas de software modernas e ambientes de nuvem (AWS) para facilitar o diálogo com equipes de engenharia e avaliar a viabilidade técnica de novas funcionalidades

Benefits

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers. We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization. We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

  • You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:
  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Experience deploying ML systems serving 100M+ predictions daily
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES

  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

The Account Director is accountable for ensuring every customer achieves measurable growth every quarter.

You own outcomes — not activity. You drive real results that customers care about: increased traffic, improved search and AI visibility, stronger conversions, and tangible pipeline impact.

You’ll lead a team of Strategists and Editors, ensuring they deliver consistent excellence without needing you in every conversation. You’ll set the playbook, remove blockers, develop talent, and intervene only when your experience is needed most.

You’ll stay closely involved with our most strategic customers, using your judgment to know when to step in and when to let your team lead. Ultimately, you own the numbers: retention, quality, growth, and customer success.

Who You Are

  • Outcome-Driven Leader: You’ve personally driven measurable growth — traffic, rankings, conversions — and know what actually works.
  • Strategic Operator: You can zoom out to define the strategy and zoom in when high-stakes execution demands your attention.
  • Systems Thinker: You turn insights into playbooks that scale across accounts and teams.
  • Talent Developer: You build teams that think strategically and connect every action to customer outcomes.
  • Decisive and Pragmatic: You act quickly on what matters and avoid unnecessary complexity or process theater.
  • Accountable: You own results. When retention or performance dips, you take responsibility — and fix it fast.

You might be a fit if you…

  • Have 5+ years experience in either:
  • Demonstrated expertise in Growth Marketing roles, creating and implementing growth strategies that drove real results.
  • Are comfortable talking SEO strategy with the C-suite at Enterprise tech companies.
  • Are an excellent communicator with a track record of building strong client relationships.
  • Have a commercial mindset — you understand client value, spot growth opportunities, and know how to align solutions with business outcomes.
  • Can confidently quarterback across internal teams (product, engineering, design) to advocate for your clients while protecting internal bandwidth.
  • Are highly organized, detail-driven, and great at managing competing priorities.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments and love building from scratch.
  • Are intellectually curious, and have heavily experimented with or implemented AI and automation tools in your daily work.
  • Can do the work yourself. We don’t want someone who points at other people to get things done.

What you’ll do

  • Drive Customer Outcomes
    • Ensure every account has a clear, measurable growth plan.
    • Review performance metrics (traffic, rankings, AI visibility, conversions) regularly.
    • Double down on winning strategies and cut losing efforts quickly.
    • Translate performance into business impact and communicate that story to customers.
    • Step in to course-correct when accounts fall short of growth targets.
  • Lead and Develop the Team
    • Build and coach a high-performing team that connects work to business outcomes.
    • Teach strategic thinking — not just task execution.
    • Remove barriers before they become emergencies.
    • Identify and address performance or fit issues decisively.
    • Create a culture of accountability, learning, and customer obsession.
  • Own the Systems and Playbooks
    • Build playbooks around what actually drives results — not theory.
    • Identify performance patterns across accounts to replicate success.
    • Design frameworks for opportunity identification and prioritization.
    • Implement scalable systems to maintain quality as the organization grows.
  • Manage the Portfolio Strategically
    • Oversee the full customer portfolio with attention to risk, retention, and expansion.
    • Maintain high Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).
    • Identify expansion opportunities through proven performance gains.
    • Ensure consistent delivery standards across all accounts and functions.
  • Lead Strategic Accounts
    • Partner directly with executive stakeholders at key accounts.
    • Participate in MBRs/QBRs and renewal or expansion conversations.
    • Build trust with senior client leaders and ensure GrowthX.AI is viewed as a strategic growth partner.
    • Stay involved in critical accounts where stakes and visibility are highest.

Perks

    • Work from anywhere—your productivity, your space!

  • Verifica os produtos nas bancas, geladeira e depósito para verificar a qualidade dos mesmos e se necessita de reposição;
  • Verifica no sistema Consinco se os produtos que estão na loja batem com o que pede no sistema.
  • Verifica e-mail e acompanha vendas da loja e setor;

  • Verifica se as alterações de preços foram realizadas;
  • Verifica e acompanha o uso de uniformes e EPIs da equipe;
  • Solicita punições a colaboradores na ausência do supervisor;
  • Realiza reuniões com a equipe para saber o andamento das atividades no período da tarde;

  • Recebe e confere mercadorias no depósito e verificar a qualidade das mesmas;
  • Faz notas de devolução e realiza plantões aos domingos, sempre com suporte de um supervisor;
  • Realiza atendimento ao cliente e resolver problemas quando o supervisor estiver ausente;
  • Realiza contagens de mercadorias (sem abrir lote) para evitar perdas;
  • Monta exposição de produtos de acordo com folheto corporativo;
  • Solicita cartazes e auxilia na arrumação do depósito, no descarte de mercadorias e na reposição de produtos nas bancas;
  • Faz o preenchimento da planilha de avarias, se atentando a quantidade do que está sendo descartado;
  • Auxilia na limpeza das câmaras frias e sala de preparo, e realiza inventários do setor;
  • Analisa e gera relatórios de ABC de entrada, estoque e produtos sem movimentação;
  • Participa das reuniões com equipe de supervisores e Gerente Geral, e realiza outras atividades correlatas à sua função e aos procedimentos do seu processo de trabalho.

Qualificações:

  • Noções da área comercial, vendas e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Será um diferencial: experiência em varejo, preferencialmente supermercadista.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo. Desejável Ensino Superior cursando ou completo.
  • Prazer em Servir e Encantar o Cliente
  • Habilidades no pacote office em especial Excel.

Já falamos tudo o que esperamos de você, agora é hora de contar um pouco do que oferecemos para todos que fazem parte do nosso time:

Nossos Benefícios: Plano de saúde e odontológico referências em nossas áreas de atuação; Refeição na empresa com desconto de R$50,00 ao mês; Vale Transporte; Desconto nas Compras realizadas com o crachá; Convênio com Farmácias; Empréstimo Consignado entre outros benefícios que exigem maior tempo de casa.

E tem mais: O Enxuto investe constantemente em ações de desenvolvimento, oferece oportunidade para primeiro emprego, para profissionais experientes ou não, e prezamos pela diversidade, para nós o que importa é o Quere r, a Vontade de fazer o melhor todos os dias, o prazer em Servir e Encantar os nossos clientes internos e externos.

Prezamos por valorizar nossos talentos, por isso, constantemente divulgamos nossas oportunidades primeiramente para quem já faz parte do time, ou seja, você pode iniciar em uma área e ir aproveitando as oportunidades internas.

Importante: Nossos Valores são vividos no dia-a-dia e é crucial que você se identifique com eles: Honestidade, União, Respeito, Profissionalismo, Evolução e Responsabilidade Socioambiental. É a prática desses valores que garantirá que tenhamos uma história sólida onde todos saiam ganhando.

Venha fazer parte da nossa história!

  • Step 3: Teste de Raciocínio Lógico e Numérico 3 Teste de Raciocínio Lógico e Numérico

SOBRE O ENXUTO

Completando 61 anos de história neste ano, e marcando presença em Campinas, Cosmópolis, Limeira e Piracicaba, o Enxuto busca oferecer aos clientes todo o frescor e qualidade de seus produtos, seja de Enxuto Origem ou Enxuto Desde 1963, nossas marcas próprias.

Em 2018, lançamos uma nova bandeira, o Enxuto Aqui, que alia o melhor da experiência digital e do atendimento humanizado em uma loja container customizada, dentro de condomínios residenciais, a fim de abastecer os lares dos consumidores com um mix diverso e itens práticos e rápidos. Hoje já possuímos mais de 30 lojas de Enxuto Aqui espalhadas por Campinas, Paulínia, Valinhos, Itupeva, Americana e Sumaré.

Prezamos pelo bem-estar dos nossos consumidores, por isso oferecemos tecnologia e inovação para fazer a diferença, e procuramos ser um lugar acolhedor e confortável para que todos encontrem o que precisam. Afinal, nós somos o Enxuto, o supermercado da nossa gente!

Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Responsabilidades

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial)

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Informações adicionais

  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

title: Senior Information Security Engineer (GRC)
description:
Senior Information Security Engineer (GRC)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About The Role
As an Information Security Engineer focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) at Clutch, you will own and mature our trust foundation. You will operationalize our security controls, drive evidence collection and continuous monitoring, and partner with product, engineering, and business teams to reduce risk while enabling speed.

About The Team
You will join a small, high‑impact Security team that partners closely with Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, and GTM. We value outcome‑oriented builders, clear documentation, and automation over manual audits. We work in the open, do frequent retros, and iterate quickly to support a rapidly scaling fintech SaaS platform serving credit unions and their members.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Baseline our control library mapped to SOC 2, PCI DSS, and key fintech obligations. Stand up gaps and remediation owners in our ticketing system.
  • Implement lightweight evidence collection pipelines for top controls such as access reviews, backup tests, vulnerability management, and CI/CD change management.
  • Complete a security risk register refresh with likelihood and impact ratings, and publish a quarterly risk report.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Lead our next SOC 2 Type II audit cycle end‑to‑end, including auditor coordination, population requests, and walkthroughs.
  • Roll out a vendor risk management workflow integrated with procurement and Legal, including tiering, due diligence, and continuous monitoring.
  • Partner with Engineering to define secure SDLC checkpoints and automate evidence from GitHub, CI, and cloud.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Drive PCI DSS certification readiness, including SoA ownership, internal audits, and management review inputs.
  • Establish KPI/KRIs and dashboards for control effectiveness and risk trends consumed by execs and customers.
  • Mature incident response playbooks and conduct at least one cross‑functional tabletop with measurable improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in GRC, security engineering, or risk management within SaaS or fintech environments.
  • Proven experience running SOC 2 Type II and working toward ISO 27001, including evidence automation and auditor interactions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security controls across AWS, containerized workloads, and modern CI/CD.
  • Practical knowledge of secure SDLC, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and third‑party risk.
  • Ability to translate requirements into actionable, ticketed work with clear owners and due dates.
  • Excellent written communication for policies, customer questionnaires, and exec‑level reporting.
  • Nice to have: experience with privacy programs, PCI readiness, or financial services regulations; relevant certs (e.g., CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 LI/LA) are a plus.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere.
  • Unforgettable Off‑Sights: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: 20 PTO days yearly and national holidays.
  • Stock Options: Receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Budget for work-related trips and co‑working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aiming to revolutionize the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. We develop software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and help them responsibly lend to over 130M Americans.

Contractor Position

This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Speechify’s text-to-speech products are used by over 50 million people to turn PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, and websites into audio so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Our products include iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google named Speechify Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work at Speechify in a distributed setting with no office. This includes frontend and backend engineers, AI researchers, and others from major tech companies and universities.

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams – Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

  • Excellent communication skills
  • User-oriented problem solving approach

Bonus

  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room

  • JUnit

  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.

title: Senior Data Scientist | Generative AI
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist in our Generative AI area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Multimodal Extraction : Apply state-of-the-art tools (OCR, vision-language models, document understanding frameworks) to interpret diverse input types;
  • Prompt Engineering : Develop and refine strategies for using LLMs to extract, summarize, and transform unstructured content into structured formats;
  • Data Quality & Structuring : Clean, validate, and transform messy, unstructured data into well-defined schemas ready for use in training or analytics pipelines;
  • Content Filtering : Define standards and build systems for cleaning, validating, and filtering data to ensure accuracy, reduce bias, and align with ethical/safety guidelines;
  • Human-in-the-Loop Feedback : Design feedback loops where experts validate or enrich data, improving LLM-based extraction reliability;
  • Scalability & Optimization : Architect cost-efficient, high-throughput data pipelines that are robust to noisy or incomplete sources;
  • Research & Prototyping : Experiment with emerging tools and methods in the LLM + multimodal space, exploring new ways to enhance information coverage and extraction reliability;
  • Collaboration : Partner with data engineers and other data scientists to integrate collected data into larger AI and analytics systems;
  • Live the mission : inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Master’s degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field;
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries for web scraping, OCR (e.g., Tesseract, EasyOCR), and NLP (e.g., HuggingFace Transformers);
  • Deep understanding of LLM capabilities in multimodal and extraction contexts, including prompt engineering and few-shot learning;
  • Strong background in unstructured data processing: APIs, web scraping, HTML parsing, OCR, image/document analysis;
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with a track record of turning noisy data into high-quality datasets for ML;
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence across technical and product teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with visual-language models (e.g., BLIP, Donut, or LayoutLM) and multimodal pipelines;
  • Hands-on experience in prompt engineering and few-shot learning for data extraction tasks;
  • Experience deploying or supporting data acquisition systems in production environments.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in data science and Pythonare mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on ourcareers page!

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn

The mission of the role

As the Missions Sales Director, you will lead satellite sales to Governments across your defined territory. You will be responsible for growing sales opportunities within the region, including upselling from the existing customer base.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world‑leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy - day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high‑resolution imagery and high‑frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real‑time data creates a tactical advantage for mission‑critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural‑catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil‑spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Expected outcomes & Competencies

  • Develop and qualify the Northern LATAM market for ICEYE's sovereign and turnkey ISR missions
  • Define and execute a regional Go‑To‑Market strategy, grounded in structured market intelligence to inform ICEYE's global Missions strategy, prioritize target markets, and guide resource allocation
  • Initiate and lead at least three strategic ISR sales campaigns in the first year
  • Grow and develop a multi‑year satellite sales pipeline ), establishing a sustainable foundation for long‑term growth and recurring government partnerships across the region
  • Establish ICEYE as a recognized ISR leader and trusted partner in Northern LATAM through consistent engagement with government institutions, local primes, and industry events
  • Drive collaboration with ICEYE's Data and Solutions sales teams to identify and close integrated ISR and data opportunities, ensuring coherent positioning and value creation across product lines

Role‑specific competences

  • 5+ years of sales experience within the Aerospace, Defense or Space industry
  • 5+ years of International sales export experience
  • 5+ years experience with earth observation, preferably SAR
  • Existing network to all levels of Government and Government Organisations in your market.

  • Proven experience in managing high‑level relationships with MoDs, Air Forces, and Space Agencies
  • Ability to speak the local language

Missions key competences

  • Intellectual Firepower: Rapidly comprehends, structures and synthesizes complex information, draws accurate conclusions, and communicates them with clarity.
  • Passion & Work Ethic: Brings sustained motivation, resilience, and high personal standards to every challenge.
  • Ownership & Action: Assumes full accountability for outcomes, acting decisively, and ensuring commitments are delivered.
  • Team Player: Works collaboratively across teams, contributing to shared success, and engaging in constructive debate.
  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Operates with transparency and humility, learns from setbacks, and actively seeks opportunities to grow.

Benefits

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale‑up approach
  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment
  • Time for self‑development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes
  • Base salary range for this position is contingent on your experience level, and will be negotiated individually.

title: Country Manager - Brazil
description:
Overview

Country Manager - Brazil role at Bitso Brasil .

As Bitso’s Country Manager for Brazil, you will be the face of our business in one of the most important markets in Latin America. This role is at the heart of Bitso’s mission: making crypto useful and accessible to millions of people. You will ensure our global strategies are adapted to local needs, lead regulatory and corporate affairs, build relationships with customers and partners, and help drive business growth. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of the crypto ecosystem in Brazil, working with a high-impact team across Latin America.

What You Will Do

  • Act as Bitso’s primary spokesperson in Brazil with media, regulators, clients, partners, and the community.
  • Lead market intelligence efforts, providing ongoing insights about customer behavior, competitors, regulation, and the economy.
  • Translate local insights into actionable go-to-market strategies in close collaboration with Bitso’s global Retail and Business teams.
  • Represent Bitso before regulators and serve as legal representative for regulated entities in Brazil.
  • Build strong relationships with government authorities, regulators, and industry associations.
  • Champion customer needs locally, ensuring Bitso’s global product suite delivers a seamless and relevant experience for Brazilian users.
  • Support Bitso Business (B2B) and Retail growth by engaging with strategic clients, partners, and influencers.
  • Drive community engagement by collaborating with Marketing and Comms teams to design and execute local events and campaigns.
  • Actively contribute to regional and global planning, ensuring Brazil’s perspective and needs are included in company-wide strategies.

Who You Are

  • Proven track record in building and leading teams, preferably in fintech, crypto, payments, or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory and financial ecosystem, including relationships with regulators, banks, payment institutions, and fintech associations.
  • Experience as a public spokesperson, with demonstrable success engaging with media, regulators, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strategic business development background, with experience negotiating partnerships and supporting sales pipelines.
  • Ability to synthesize complex local trends into actionable strategies and communicate them clearly to global leadership.
  • Experience working cross-functionally in regional or global organizations, balancing local priorities with global objectives.
  • Legal and compliance awareness, able to act as legal representative with personal accountability.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (Spanish desirable).
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and passion for crypto and Bitso’s mission.

Your Team

You will collaborate closely with Bitso’s General Managers (Retail and Bitso Business), as well as global functions such as Policy, Product, Legal, Finance, and Operations.

Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products. So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

title: Release Manager - CI/CD
description:
Overview

Ifdigital transformation,next generation technologyandgrowth opportunitiesexcite you, then apply to join our Netcracker Technology Team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams, earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world.

What is in it for you?

At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.

Scope of this role

We are looking to hire a Release Engineer to join our growing company. This position will be part of our Engineering department based in our Sao Paolo office in Brazil. The role will maximize the engagement metrics of Netcracker’s digital properties, as well as the software release configurations according to Customers requirements for projects around the world. Role and responsibilities are:

  • Execute tracking and alignment of software components included on solution
  • Track component versions, branches and merges – GIT advanced user (GIT maintainer as a benefit)
  • Approve merges to the branch, including merge conflict’s resolution
  • Prepare release documentation: Release Notes, Proof of tests, installation notes
  • Track and manage the solution configuration
  • Ticket management
  • Maintain the CI/CD with the DevOps team assistance – Jenkins advanced user as a benefit
  • Run, monitor and do pipeline’s first triage
  • Involve respective teams to keep CI/CD green on daily basis as the POC
  • Change management (CRs & HF) - Coordination of new scope and fix issue plans
  • Managing the lifecycle of a change
  • Work with ITMSO on SIS plan build and validation
  • Prepare Production and non-Production environment’s update: communication plan, installation plan, roll-back plan and others as required
  • Run Production and non-Production environment’s update: HF/DF/Maintenance patch deployment
  • Manage deployment issues and troubleshooting
  • POC for Internal Release management, alignment of the installation plan with the stakeholders (Configuration / Environment support / Deployment Management / Solution delivery / Customer support)

Skills & Requirements

  • Release Planning and Coordination - Manage release schedules, timelines, and calendars;
  • Change Management – knowledge of change control processes, and governance, ITIL knowledge desired;
  • Documentation: Prepare release notes, rollback plans, and compliance reports;
  • CI/CD Understanding: Comprehend pipelines, branching strategies, and automated deployments (coding not required);
  • Environment and Configuration Management – Understand staging, pre-production and production environments;
  • Risk Management: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate release-related risks;
  • Scripting and Automation: Basic familiarity with Bash, PowerShell, or Python for effective communication with engineers;
  • Source Control Management – Knowledge on Git branching, merging, tagging, conflict resolution.

Soft Skills

  • Communication and Stakeholder Management – acting as a bridge between development, QA, operations, and business teams;
  • Conflict Resolution: Address and resolve disagreements between development and operations;
  • Leadership: Guide and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct formal authority;
  • Decision-Making Under Pressure: Confidently approve or stop releases in high-stakes scenarios;
  • Organization and Time Management: Prioritize and manage multiple releases while meeting SLAs;
  • Documentation Discipline: Maintain clear runbooks, deployment instructions, and troubleshooting guides;
  • Adaptability and Proactivity: Respond effectively to last-minute changes and identify opportunities for improvement;
  • Attention to Detail: Detect gaps in testing, approvals or dependencies before release;
  • Problem-Solving: Identify and address deployment failures or unexpected behaviors.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field

About Netcracker Technology

We are a forward-looking software company, offering mission-critical solutions to service providers around the globe. Our comprehensive portfolio of software solutions and professional services enables large-scale digital transformations, unlocking the opportunities of the cloud, analytics, virtualization, and 5G mobile networks. With an unbroken service delivery track record of more than 25 years, our unique combination of technology, people and expertise helps companies transform their networks and enable better experiences for their customers.

Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. title: SENIOR SAP BASIS ANALYST (32631)
description:
Overview

Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações technológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Temos uma promessa sólida para nossos colaboradores: crescemos juntos, gostamos do nosso trabalho e inspiramos uns aos outros. Junte-se a nós e sinta a diferença.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Adapt and perform database (Oracle, HANA, MAXDB) and kernel upgrades/patching.
  • Execute database recovery procedures as needed or in emergency situations.
  • Support incident tickets and alerts handling escalated from the Daily Operations team.
  • Consult on and coordinate changes to hardware resources.
  • Consult with and participate in customer projects.
  • Participate in regular operational meetings.
  • Conduct performance analysis, optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Provide 3rd and 4th level technical support during working hours.
  • Lead or support 8D and 5-Why problem ticket investigations, and provide comprehensive Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Implement changes based on security requirements.
  • Consult on and support the implementation of Alert & Monitoring configuration templates.

Qualificações

Minimum Qualifications

  • English – Advanced
  • Experience in managing SAP S/4HANA Systems
  • Exposure to SAP Implementations, Version Upgrades or OS/DB Migrations

Essential Technical Skill Set:

  • Expertise in Implementation of SAP Systems such as S/4 HANA, BW/4 HANA, Fiori Implementation
  • Configuration on Hybrid Environments (IaaS & PaaS)
  • Expertise in SAP Release/EHP Upgrades or OS/DB Migrations/Conversions
  • Expertise in Managing Complex Production Landscape Systems (SAP S/4 HANA, BW/4 HANA, PO, BO, Solman 7.2)
  • Experience with Business Continuity Solutions such as HA / DR Failover
  • Solutions for SAP landscapes
  • Deep knowledge in Database Administration of SAP HANA and Oracle, including DB Patching
  • Version Upgrade with performance tuning, sizing and storage/disk design
  • Strong knowledge of Linux and AIX operating systems including performance analysis and debugging
  • Exposure to New SAP releases, enhancements, new functionality and application research
  • Strong knowledge in SAP Security Hardening and Performance tuning
  • Strong knowledge in Automating SAP Operations (Scripts, SAP LAMA & Tools) is an added advantage
  • SAP Certification in S/4 HANA Conversion / Migration or HANA DB is an added advantage

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Certification in S/4 HANA Conversion / Migration or HANA DB is an added advantage

Informações adicionais

Benefícios da Bosch

  • Programas de Bem-Estar e Saúde: avaliação preventiva anual, ambulatório dentro da localidade para atendimento durante o horário de trabalho, programa antitabagismo, programa de saúde mental, fisioterapia e curso de gestante
  • Assistência médica e odontológica
  • Política de reembolso para algumas condições especiais de saúde
  • Subsídio para medicamentos através da Funcional Health
  • Jornadas de trabalho flexível com política de home office (não aplicado para horistas)
  • Short Friday para administrativo e horista do turno normal (apenas em Campinas)
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados (PLR)
  • Política de expatriação internacional e de transferências nacionais
  • Plano de previdência privada e empréstimos com taxas diferenciadas
  • Seguro de vida
  • Associação opcional ao Clube da Bosch dentro da planta com academia, piscinas, churrasqueiras, campos de futebol e society, espaço para eventos, ginásio de esportes, quadras de areia, quadra de tênis, lanchonete e calendário anual de eventos
  • Auxílio para mamães com creche na planta (verificar vagas disponíveis)
  • Licença maternidade e adoção estendida de 180 dias
  • Licença paternidade e adoção de 20 dias
  • Alimentação no local de trabalho e Vale Alimentação
  • Ônibus fretado (ou Vale Transporte)
  • Estacionamento gratuito (para quem vem presencial)
  • Benefícios de fim de ano com Cesta de Natal e ave congelada
  • Brinquedo para filhos menores de 12 anos
  • Material escolar para colaboradores (até nível universitário) e filhos (até final do ensino médio)
  • Política de subsídios para cursos técnicos, pós-graduação, MBA, especializações e idiomas
  • Treinamentos e capacitações através da nossa universidade corporativa
  • Premiação por tempo de casa (a partir de 10 anos e a cada 5 anos)
  • Participação opcional em várias ações de voluntariado via Instituto Robert Bosch
  • Descontos com parceiros do clube: locação de veículos, mensalidade em universidades, cursos de idioma, lojas e outros

Leia nossos artigos no Medium e saiba como é trabalhar na área de Tecnologia da Bosch Brasil: Bosch Tech Brasil – Medium

Informações adicionais

- Vaga elegível para pessoas com deficiência ou reabilitadas

- Não contratamos menores de 16 anos e somos contra o trabalho infantil

- Modelo de trabalho: Home Office

- Se esta vaga for elegível ao modelo Home Office, a avaliação do posto de trabalho será uma das etapas do processo seletivo

- Área contratante: SO/OPM-TS13-BR

Para colaboradores Bosch

- Prazo: 17/10/2025

- Sua candidatura pode ser feita internamente pelo site SmartHub

- Após se candidatar, recomendamos informar a sua liderança

- Verifique a elegibilidade desta vaga em nosso Programa de Indicações “Indica Ai” (conforme RCD )

Na Bosch, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação, por isso, todas as vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência, em situação vulnerável e grupos minoritários.

description:
Overview

The LA AI & Data Center of Excellence seeks a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our team. This role focuses on developing and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, emphasizing automation, software engineering best practices, and production-ready code. This role requires proficiency in Python programming and experience with various machine learning, deep learning, generative and agentic AI.

The successful candidate will work on projects across diverse business units, directly impacting critical decision-making and driving innovation.

You will lead the development of intelligent systems with a strong emphasis on software and AI engineering best practices, automation, and continuous delivery.

Experience and knowledge (Mandatory)

Experience and knowledge (Mandatory):

Strong experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering roles, demonstrating a history of delivering impactful AI solutions.

Expert-level Python programming, including Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and experience with RESTful API development. Experience with Flask/FastAPI for API development is a plus.

Strong software engineering foundation: Version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, Clean Code principles, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

Strong understanding of programming logic and object-oriented programming (OOP) principles to design modular, reusable, and maintainable code structures.

Proven experience in end-to-end ML (Machine Learning) lifecycle: data preparation, model training, tuning, inference, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

Data handling expertise: Extraction, cleaning, transformation, and loading (ETL) from various sources (relational and non-relational databases, cloud storage, APIs). Experience with SQL, NoSQL and vector databases.

Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, time series, and NLP (Natural Language Processing).

Natural Language Processing (NLP): Experience with text preprocessing, pre-trained models (BERT, Roberta), fine-tuning, and NLP libraries (scikit-learn, spaCy, NLTK, Gensim).

Experience with Generative AI (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines).

Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred), GCP or AWS, including their respective AI/ML services (e.g., Azure AI services).

Strong understanding of model evaluation, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning.

Experience and knowledge (Desirable)

Experience and knowledge (Desirable):

Hands-on experience with multi-agent systems and autonomous AI agents (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LangFlow), including the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Familiarity with data engineering: experience with data warehousing, and big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks).

Experience with MLOps tools and practices: MLFlow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.

Experience working with knowledge graphs and graph-based data representations, including tools like Neo4j, RDF, SPARQL, Stardog or graph neural networks for reasoning and relationship modeling.

Domain knowledge (e.g.: experience in industry, laws, HR, marketing, etc.).

Ability to assess the business impact and profitability of AI models, including cost-benefit analysis, ROI estimation, and value tracking post-deployment.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or Physics.

Personality and working method: team player, problem-solving, analytical thinking, pro-active, self-taught, and resilient.

Strong communication & collaboration: ability to translate technical insights into accessible information for diverse audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in agile, cross-functional teams.

Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with AI advancements

Languages: Portuguese (Brazilian) and fluent in English. German is a plus.

title: Coordenador de Demanda - S&OP
description:
Overview

Somos uma empresa farmacêutica brasileira que há mais de 65 anos trata da vida. Com o propósito de "transformar conhecimento em saúde pra sua vida", construímos nossa história com ousadia, inovação e espírito visionário.

Nossa razão de existir é promover saúde de alta qualidade para que as pessoas possam aproveitar cada momento. Temos um amplo portfólio de medicamentos de diversas especialidades, como ginecologia, oncologia e cardiologia, para atender os pacientes em sua integralidade e individualidade, com formulações eficientes e inovadoras. São mais de 100 marcas em mais de 200 apresentações.

Queremos que aqui você encontre o seu lugar! Somos considerados um excelente lugar pra se trabalhar, segundo o GPTW. Estabelecemos relações de transparência e confiança com nossos mais de 3 mil colaboradores e estimulamos a mobilidade como ferramenta de desenvolvimento profissional. A saúde e bem-estar norteiam nossas decisões.

Responsibilities

  • Ser o responsável pela governança do processo de Demand Planning dentro do ciclo de S&OP, garantindo alinhamento para evolução do IBP e estratégia corporativa.
  • Liderar a construção do consenso de demanda final que será validado nas reuniões executivas de S&OP.
  • Fortalecer a gestão de portfólio dentro do S&OP, assegurando que cada phase-in e phase-out aconteça de forma fluida, com disciplina e alinhamento estratégico, transformando lançamentos e descontinuações em vantagem competitiva.
  • Assegurar a integração do plano de demanda com planos de supply, financeiro e portfólio de produtos.
  • Promover a maturidade do processo de S&OP, fortalecendo cultura de dados e colaboração interfuncional.
  • Conduzir o ciclo mensal de Demand Review, desde a análise estatística inicial até a preparação do consenso.
  • Gerar a previsão estatística (baseline forecast) com base em históricos, modelos matemáticos, sazonalidade e tendências.
  • Integrar inputs de Marketing, Comercial, Inteligência de Mercado e Supply, consolidando-os em cenários de previsão.
  • Desafiar premissas e vieses trazidos pelas áreas comerciais, de marketing e portfólio, buscando equilíbrio entre ambição e realismo.
  • Gerar análises de BIAS, Forecast Accuracy, FVA e MAPE, comunicando desvios e ações corretivas.
  • Consolidar riscos e oportunidades de demanda, propondo cenários alternativos para a reunião executiva de S&OP.
  • Apoiar e desafiar o time de portfólio em análises de lançamentos, descontinuações e ciclo de vida de produtos.
  • Garantir aderência ao calendário global de S&OP, mantendo disciplina no cumprimento das etapas.
  • Extrair, limpar e tratar dados de vendas históricas no ERP/APS.
  • Rodar modelos estatísticos e gerar relatórios de baseline por SKU, categoria, canal e mercado.
  • Atualizar dashboards semanais/mensais de previsão (Power BI, etc.).
  • Conduzir workshops de alinhamento de demanda com áreas envolvidas.
  • Consolidar informações e preparar materiais para o Demand Review Meeting.
  • Manter registro formal de premissas, riscos e decisões tomadas.
  • Suportar auditorias e revisões de governança sobre o processo de S&OP.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Sistema de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na área de Supply Chain, Planejamento de Demanda ou Planejamento de Suprimentos.
  • Domínio em modelagem estatística de Forecast e ferramentas de previsão de demanda.
  • Conhecimento e prática nas auditorias do mercado farmacêutico: IQVIA e Close UP.
  • Noções de finanças e custos operacionais e gestão de estoque.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Excel (Pacote Office) e sistemas ERP como SAP.
  • Estabelecer e manter o princípio de One Number / One Source of Truth, evitando desalinhamentos ou múltiplas versões de dados.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau), Alteryx.

Informações adicionais

  • Local de trabalho (Base): Teletrabalho (disponibilidade para encontros presenciais pontuais durante o ano).
  • Horário: Segunda à Sexta – Horário Móvel (Entrada entre 7h – 9h e saída entre 16h – 18h).

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Medicamentos Libbs - 100%;
  • Convênio Farmácia – Vidalink;
  • PPR - Programa de Participação dos Lucros e Resultados da companhia;
  • Estacionamento, vale transporte ou fretado (aplicável somente para atuação em turnos).
  • Programa USE: subsídio para compra do equipamento que será utilizado para o trabalho, podendo utilizá-lo para fins pessoais;
  • Benefícios flexíveis (TotalPass, seguro de vida, previdência privada, assistência médica, odontológica e auxílio alimentação).

Overview

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care. Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

A Transzilli é uma empresa com 35 anos de experiência no transporte de cargas secas, refrigeradas e congeladas por todo o território nacional. Estamos em busca de um Condutor de Veículos Pesados (Truck) para nossa equipe em São Paulo. As responsabilidades diárias deste cargo incluem conduzir caminhões na rota do Mato Grosso do Sul. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e exige presença no local.

  • Regulamentações: Conhecimento das regulamentações do DOT para transporte rodoviário e compliance.

title: OPERADOR LOGÍSTICA IN COMPANY (CAMAÇARI/BA)
description:
A Nortel é uma empresa do grupo Sonepar. Desde 1966 é referência no setor de MRO (manutenção, reparação e operação), com filiais espalhadas em todo território nacional.

Acreditamos que o segredo do nosso sucesso está na valorização de um ambiente de trabalho sensacional, que impulsiona nossa gente a buscar sempre a superação de seus objetivos pessoais e profissionais. Trabalhar na Nortel é fazer parte de uma empresa dinâmica, que reconhece seus talentos e incentiva você a buscar sempre o seu melhor. Pioneira no segmento, a Nortel tem como principal objetivo Simplificar a Vida de Seus Clientes, diferenciando-se das demais empresas em seu catálogo de produtos e serviços, buscando sempre a excelência e a atenção às necessidades de seus clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Separar ou armazenar materiais com qualidade e assertividade, seguindo os processos corretamente, para garantir a acuracidade do estoque.
  • Realizar a sugestão de indicações de ajustes de inventário/estoque forçado através de comunicação com a liderança para manter o correto abastecimento
  • Fazer o armazenamento e a estocagem de materiais utilizando a metodologia PEPS ou FIFO (Primeiro que Entra, Primeiro que Sai) ou (First In, First Out) para correta gestão do estoque
  • Realizar o controle e Inventário do Certificado de Aprovação de EPI's e FISPQ (Ficha de Inspeção de Produto Químico) através das informações recebidas pelo fabricante para correta gestão do estoque
  • Fazer a gestão e abastecimento das Vending Machines realizando seu abastecimento e inventários a fim de garantir seu correto funcionamento
  • Separar pedidos e Requisições de Materiais através da solicitação do cliente para entrega de produtos ao cliente.
  • Extrair relatórios do Allianza através de informações extraídas do sistema para envio ao cliente, medição do estoque das vending machines/lojas
  • Viajar ocasionalmente quando solicitado para outras unidades do grupo para efetuar suporte operacional, conforme programação necessária instruída pelo Gestor imediato, para atender uma demanda específica e sazonal.
  • Movimentar volumes na área de conferência e expedição para transporte, usando os carrinhos de movimentação a triagem dos volumes para os Stages de expedição, e garantir a disponibilidade de volumes para expedição/transporte.
  • Organizar e manter limpeza do departamento utilizando o conceito 5S. para manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Camaçari/BA
  • Experiência com Logística será um diferencial

Benefícios:

Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Refeição, Vale transporte, Seguro de Vida, Gympass, PLR, Acesso a Plataforma de Idiomas GoFluent.

Programa de Apoio Optum: Em parceria com a Ifood, para orientação psicológica e social extensivo aos familiares, sem custo ao Colaborador, com acesso mediante contato telefônico;

Todos os candidatos qualificados serão avaliados para oportunidades de emprego com base em seus méritos, sem discriminação por motivo de raça, cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional ou deficiência.
Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas para pessoas com deficiência e sua candidatura é especialmente bem-vinda.
