title: Head of Engineering (Payments)
description:
Overview

Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we're on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs. We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We've been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market. Our goal is to deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike. We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action and are looking for curious, hands-on people who want to solve real problems and rethink what’s possible. If you're ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and scale a team of engineers, promoting a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Remain actively involved in system architecture decisions and complex problem-solving
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment between business goals and technology execution
  • Define and drive engineering best practices across development, testing, deployment, and observability
  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders, fostering career growth and technical development
  • Participate in technical hiring and shape team structure and engineering processes
  • Promote AI-assisted engineering practices within squads and chapters, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation
  • Guide conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration
  • Define and drive the tribe’s technical vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives
  • Partner with Squad Leaders and Product counterparts to shape roadmaps, identify trade-offs, and prioritize delivery
  • Mentor and develop Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Tech Leads
  • Promote high standards in software architecture, observability, reliability, and scalability
  • Ensure teams are resourced, structured, and supported to deliver value with speed and quality
  • Contribute to talent strategy: hiring, succession planning, career development, and performance management of engineering leadership
  • Serve as the primary interface between engineering and the Tribe Lead, supporting delivery accountability and risk management
  • Collaborate with the VP of Engineering and other Heads of Engineering to uphold chapter-wide standards
  • Guide architectural decisions and governance, facilitating technical forums and peer reviews at tribe level
  • Champion AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, maintainability, and code quality
  • Establish and monitor key technical KPIs (reliability, velocity, tech debt, performance) across squads
  • Lead by example in cultivating an inclusive, empowering engineering culture rooted in ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Requirements

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related disciplines
  • Extensive experience in senior engineering leadership roles within product-centric technology companies
  • Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot, with knowledge of relational databases, data modeling, and insights via reporting tools and dashboards
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems and working with AWS
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and microservices
  • Understanding of software architecture, clean code, and scalability in high-throughput or fintech/regulatory environments
  • Knowledge of modern software quality practices, including automated testing, code reviews, observability, and performance optimization
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (code generation, test automation, documentation)
  • Proven ability to lead and scale engineering teams across multiple squads
  • Experience managing Engineering Managers and building layered leadership structures
  • Ability to define and track team OKRs and technical KPIs aligned with company goals
  • Skilled at evaluating and prioritizing technical initiatives based on business impact
  • Experience managing engineering budgets, tooling investments, and infrastructure resources
  • Strong communication skills to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to partner with cross-functional leaders from Product, Design, Business, and Operations
  • Ability to drive collaboration across squads and departments to align technical direction with product goals
  • Comfortable in dynamic, fast-paced environments, leading through influence and technical credibility
  • Track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering talent, including leaders and managers
  • Committed to inclusive, psychologically safe, and growth-oriented teams
  • Experience driving knowledge sharing and engineering best practices across teams

Industry-Specific Knowledge

As Head of Engineering, you bring deep, hands-on familiarity with core financial domains such as lending, payments, credit, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand regulatory constraints and business drivers. You will align engineering execution with product strategy and work with Squad Leaders, Product Managers, and Tribe leadership to define roadmaps and guide decision-making that balances delivery velocity, platform health, and business value. You will oversee multiple engineering teams across the tribe and translate domain needs into actionable technical direction.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary
  • Annual Award Program
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you are part of the team
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay
  • Life insurance
  • Flexible meal allowance
  • TotalPass membership for health
  • Language classes

Diversity & Inclusion

We value diverse perspectives and experiences. Everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and do not discriminate on gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic.

About The Use Of Your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados deve ser capaz de criar, expandir e otimizar a arquitetura de pipelines de dados, bem como desenvolver e manter fluxos de dados de diversas áreas de nossos clientes. description:
Gerente de Testes SAP (c/ Inglês) | Remota | PJ

Resumo

O(a) Gerente de Testes será responsável por liderar as atividades de planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de testes funcionais e integrados em ambientes SAP e sistemas corporativos relacionados. Este profissional atuará de forma estratégica, garantindo a qualidade das entregas, a aderência às metodologias de teste e o cumprimento dos prazos do projeto. Além disso, será responsável por gerir equipes multidisciplinares, reportar status a executivos e garantir o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, TI e fornecedores.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e coordenar todas as fases do ciclo de testes (unitário, integração, regressão, aceitação do usuário).
  • Elaborar e revisar estratégias, planos e cronogramas de teste.
  • Monitorar o andamento dos testes e execução de scripts, garantindo cobertura adequada dos requisitos.
  • Gerir a equipe de testes (internos e terceiros), distribuindo atividades e acompanhando performance.
  • Utilizar e administrar ferramentas ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) para controle de casos de teste, defeitos e indicadores de qualidade.
  • Gerar relatórios de progresso e métricas de qualidade para stakeholders e gestão executiva.
  • Coordenar atividades de testes em ambientes SAP, assegurando a integração entre módulos e sistemas legados.
  • Garantir que todas as entregas estejam em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade e governança definidos pelo projeto.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos na área de testes, sendo pelo menos 2 anos em gestão de testes ou liderança técnica.
  • Conhecimento sólido em planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de testes.
  • Domínio de ferramentas ALM (ex: HP ALM / Micro Focus ALM, Jira + Xray, Azure DevOps).
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes SAP (ECC ou S/4HANA).
  • Inglês avançado (capaz de conduzir reuniões e redigir relatórios técnicos).
  • Necessário disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Desejáveis

  • Experiência em projetos de implementação, rollout ou upgrade SAP.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe).
  • Certificações ISTQB, PMP ou similares.
  • Vivência em ambientes multinacionais.

Benefícios

  • Cartão ECXPAY no valor de R$ 500,00/mês para despesas operacionais;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub como cortesia empresarial;
  • Parceria com Zenklub - serviços de bem-estar (Psicólogo/Nutricionista/Coaching/Terapia);
  • 22 dias de suspensão remunerada dos serviços por ano, após 12 meses de parceria;
  • Parceria educacional com curso de línguas "Time Load";
  • Parceria com clínica Bridges (Fortaleza - CE).

title: Financial Applications Director
description:
Overview

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

Responsibilities

  • Systems Support
  • Responsible for all aspects of end-user support for financial systems, including:
    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.
  • Serve as the Business World applications ‘go-to’ person by researching software functionality, staying current on technology changes, and advising on best practices.
  • Test patches to ensure that they resolve issues as intended. Work with systems software vendors and CI’s IT department to facilitate the migration of patches to production that have passed testing. Create/maintain system configuration as needed to ensure optimal processing.
  • Maintain and manage relationships with financial systems, software, and service vendors to ensure strong working relationships, maximized levels of support, and efficient use of CI’s resources.
  • Documentation and Training
  • Develop and maintain financial systems SharePoint resource site(s) with relevant help materials for end users.
  • Draft and update financial systems user and administrative procedures as needed.
  • Conduct training for end users as required.
  • Project Management/Change Management
  • Manage financial systems team meetings. Coordinate with business process owners, super users, and other team members as needed to ensure good communication on all financial system-related issues.
  • Manage the change management system to ensure all changes to production financial systems are properly documented, approved, tested, and implemented.

Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions

  • Normal office environment.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 7 or more years of related experience.
  • 2 or more years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Applications, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Contract Accounting, Operating Budget, Project Management, and Procurement modules.
  • Solid working knowledge of database architecture and management
  • SQL Server and Visual Basic experience
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools
  • Project management skills.
  • Ability to adapt and work effectively with functional teams across the organization.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Experience in training on software applications.
  • Preferred
  • Administrator experience using Unit4 Business World
  • Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, and/or French

title: Gerente de Infraestrutura
description:
Overview

Nós sabemos bem o que desejamos: procuramos uma pessoa capaz de atuar na área de Infraestrutura , gerenciando as pessoas do time, garantindo que a entrega dos processos e serviços sejam feitas de acordo com os objetivos de negócio e com o padrão de qualidade. Se você atende aos requisitos para atuar como Gerente de Infraestrutura , e também se conecta com nossa identidade, então vamos nessa. Queremos conhecer você e as possibilidades de atuarmos juntos na construção do futuro. Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em tecnologia de identificação de pessoas e certificação de processos. Com clientes e operações em 15 estados, nossas soluções fazem parte do dia a dia de milhares de brasileiros. A atuação remota é uma realidade para nós, então mesmo que estejamos separados pela geografia brasileira, vamos conectar nossas identidades através da tecnologia, afinal, essa é uma de nossas paixões. A VSOFT é um lugar propício para você que deseja impulsionar a sua carreira e gosta de desafios, e esse pode ser o seu momento de brilhar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir o desenvolvimento e evolução profissional da sua equipe, alinhado às melhores práticas da organização;
  • Influenciar ativamente a construção de excelente ambiente de trabalho, colaborando com as ações de clima e engajamento;
  • Analisar e alocar pessoas nos times conforme suas competências e participar na seleção de novos colaboradores;
  • Gerenciar os objetivos e metas da área alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos da organização;
  • Apoiar a diretoria e demais áreas em questões referentes aos custos e viabilidade orçamentária dos projetos, produtos e pessoas;
  • Projetar, desenvolver, implementar e coordenar sistemas, políticas e procedimentos;
  • Conduzir o planejamento da área de Infraestrutura;
  • Garantir a segurança de dados, acesso à rede e sistemas de backup e firewall;
  • Trabalhar na melhoria contínua dos processos de Infraestrutura;
  • Monitorar os ambientes de homologação/produção;
  • Monitorar as redes internas da organização;
  • Supervisionar e atuar, quando necessário, nas demandas de infraestrutura oriundas de crises na operação dos produtos;
  • Preservar ativos, segurança da informação e estruturas de controle;
  • Negociar e tomar decisão de contratação de serviços e aquisição de produtos de infraestrutura;
  • Manter relacionamento com fornecedores de serviços e produtos de infraestrutura;
  • Liderar a equipe de infraestrutura de acordo com a cultura Devops.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Habilidades de gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Conhecimento em gestão estratégica;
  • Habilidades de leitura e escrita na língua inglesa (intermediário);
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas Operacionais Linux e Windows;
  • Conhecimento em Scripting (Shell Script, Python, etc);
  • Conhecimento em TCP/IP - Fundamentos e Protocolos (DNS, HTTP/s, FTP, SSL);
  • Conhecimento em Web servers e Load Balancers (Apache, Nginx, IIS, Haproxy, etc);
  • Conhecimentos em Cloud: Azure, Digital Ocean e Oracle Cloud;
